name: Dissociated Worth
source:
Everyone has their own version of the truth. Your job is to figure out who's lying.

You are someone with no skills, no connections, no power, and barely holding yourself together, sent to neutralize opponents by a powerful entity. He might want you dead, tortured, or changed, but you can't know until you piece it together. Your mind is your only weapon. Everyone has something to hide. Your goal is to discover the truth buried under lies and choose the right actions to outwit your enemies.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4341470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
每个人都有自己对真相的看法。你的工作就是找出谁在撒谎。

你是一个没有技能、没有关系、没有权力、几乎无法支撑自己的人，被一个强大的实体派去消灭对手。他可能希望你死、受折磨或改变，但除非你把它们拼凑起来，否则你无法知道。你的思想是你唯一的武器。每个人都有一些需要隐藏的事情。你的目标是发现隐藏在谎言之下的真相，并选择正确的行动来智取敌人。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4341470/]Steam[/url]]
